_comment: Dune: Awakening — Pelican egg. Runs a full Linux Docker dedicated-server battlegroup using SteamCMD anonymous downloads + CubeCoders' MIT-licensed launch scripts (mock Kubernetes API, patchelf'd Funcom OCI binaries). Requires a custom runtime Docker image built from this repo's docker/Dockerfile.
name: Dune: Awakening
author: valentin95150@hotmail.fr
description: Dune: Awakening dedicated server (full battlegroup with always-warm Survival_1, Overmap, and DeepDesert_1 plus on-demand instances). Native Linux Docker via Funcom's official OCI tarballs (Steam app 4754530 retail / 3104830 PTC), extracted and patchelf'd at install time. Orchestration ports CubeCoders' AMP module (MIT) to the Wings runtime model. Requires a custom runtime image (see docker/Dockerfile) that pre-creates /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/ with container-user ownership.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Dune: Awakening Pelican install script — fully Pelican-native.
#
# Runs in the install container (ghcr.io/parkervcp/installers:debian) with
# root and writes to /mnt/server (mounted as /home/container at runtime).
# The runtime image (see docker/Dockerfile in this repo) must be built and
# pushed to a registry the Wings host can pull from before this egg works.
#
# Steps:
#   1. apt install build-time deps
#   2. Download SteamCMD
#   3. SteamCMD anonymous download of Funcom depot
#        - 4754530 = Production (retail)
#        - 3104830 = PTC (public test)
#   4. Fetch this repo (scripts + mock-k8s source + entrypoint + applier)
#      from GitHub. No more dependency on CubeCoders' AMPTemplates tarball.
#   5. Install pinned Go from go.dev + build mock-k8s-go from source
#      (open-source MIT, stdlib + yaml.v3)
#   6. Run scripts/install.sh to extract OCI images and patchelf binaries

set -euo pipefail

SRCDS_APPID="${SRCDS_APPID:-4754530}"
STEAM_USER="${STEAM_USER:-anonymous}"
STEAM_PASS="${STEAM_PASS:-}"
STEAM_AUTH="${STEAM_AUTH:-}"
# Override at the panel level to pin a specific commit/tag rather than tracking
# main. Reproducible installs use a tag (e.g. v1.0.0) or commit SHA.
DUNE_EGG_REF="${DUNE_EGG_REF:-main}"
DUNE_EGG_REPO="${DUNE_EGG_REPO:-Sergentval/pelican-egg-dune-awakening}"

case "$SRCDS_APPID" in
    4754530|3104830) ;;
    *)
        echo "ERROR: SRCDS_APPID must be 4754530 (retail) or 3104830 (PTC); got '$SRCDS_APPID'" >&2
        exit 1
        ;;
esac

echo "==> Installing build-time dependencies..."
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
dpkg --add-architecture i386
apt-get update -q
apt-get install -y -q --no-install-recommends \
    ca-certificates curl tar gzip jq file lib32gcc-s1 libcurl4:i386 \
    patchelf iproute2 gawk python3

mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd /mnt/server/server

echo "==> Downloading SteamCMD..."
curl -fsSL https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz \
    | tar -xz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd

echo "==> Downloading Funcom Dune: Awakening server depot (app $SRCDS_APPID)..."
echo "    Depot is ~5 GB compressed; extracts to ~12 GB. Anonymous-accessible."
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd
export HOME=/mnt/server
./steamcmd.sh \
    +@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType linux \
    +force_install_dir /mnt/server/server \
    +login "$STEAM_USER" "$STEAM_PASS" "$STEAM_AUTH" \
    +app_update "$SRCDS_APPID" validate \
    +quit

if [ ! -d /mnt/server/server/images ]; then
    echo "ERROR: SteamCMD download finished but /mnt/server/server/images/ is missing." >&2
    echo "       Check the SteamCMD log above for errors (login failure, app not owned, etc.)." >&2
    exit 1
fi

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Fetch this repo's scripts + mock-k8s source. We own these — no more
# AMPTemplates curl race at install time. The scripts dir includes our
# Pelican forks of CubeCoders' launch scripts (lib.sh, prestart.sh,
# console.sh, migrate-db.sh, etc.), our pelican-entrypoint.sh, and
# apply-config.sh for the panel-variable INI substitution.
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
echo "==> Fetching Pelican egg scripts + mock-k8s source ($DUNE_EGG_REPO@$DUNE_EGG_REF)..."
DUNE_EGG_TMP=$(mktemp -d)
curl -fsSL "https://codeload.github.com/$DUNE_EGG_REPO/tar.gz/refs/heads/$DUNE_EGG_REF" \
    | tar -xz -C "$DUNE_EGG_TMP"
DUNE_EGG_SRC=$(echo "$DUNE_EGG_TMP"/*)
[ -d "$DUNE_EGG_SRC/scripts" ] || { echo "ERROR: tarball missing scripts/ — bad ref?" >&2; exit 1; }
[ -d "$DUNE_EGG_SRC/mock-k8s" ] || { echo "ERROR: tarball missing mock-k8s/ — bad ref?" >&2; exit 1; }

rm -rf /mnt/server/scripts /mnt/server/mock-k8s /mnt/server/data
cp -r "$DUNE_EGG_SRC/scripts"  /mnt/server/scripts
cp -r "$DUNE_EGG_SRC/mock-k8s" /mnt/server/mock-k8s
if [ -d "$DUNE_EGG_SRC/data" ]; then cp -r "$DUNE_EGG_SRC/data" /mnt/server/data; fi
cp "$DUNE_EGG_SRC/ATTRIBUTION.md" /mnt/server/ATTRIBUTION.md 2>/dev/null || true
chmod +x /mnt/server/scripts/*.sh /mnt/server/scripts/*.py 2>/dev/null || true

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Install Go from go.dev. Debian bookworm ships Go 1.19, but mock-k8s
# uses log/slog (added in 1.21) and go.mod declares 1.22.2. Pinned to
# 1.22.x for reproducibility; override with GO_VERSION at the panel level.
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
GO_VERSION="${GO_VERSION:-1.22.7}"
echo "==> Installing Go ${GO_VERSION} from go.dev..."
rm -rf /usr/local/go
curl -fsSL "https://go.dev/dl/go${GO_VERSION}.linux-amd64.tar.gz" \
    | tar -xz -C /usr/local
export PATH=/usr/local/go/bin:$PATH
go version

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build mock-k8s-go from source. Replaces CubeCoders' closed binary
# (anti-tamper checks refuse to run outside AMP). Our binary lands at
# /mnt/server/scripts/mock-k8s-go alongside the launch scripts.
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
echo "==> Building mock-k8s-go from source..."
export GOPATH=/tmp/dune-gopath
export GOCACHE=/tmp/dune-gocache
mkdir -p "$GOPATH" "$GOCACHE"
cd /mnt/server/mock-k8s
CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -ldflags='-s -w' \
    -o /mnt/server/scripts/mock-k8s-go ./cmd/mock-k8s
chmod +x /mnt/server/scripts/mock-k8s-go
echo "    built: $(file /mnt/server/scripts/mock-k8s-go | cut -d: -f2-)"

# Tarball + Go cache + Go toolchain no longer needed in the runtime volume
rm -rf "$DUNE_EGG_TMP" "$GOPATH" "$GOCACHE" /usr/local/go

echo "==> Extracting Funcom OCI images and patching binary loaders..."
echo "    This may take several minutes with no visible output."
cd /mnt/server
ln -snfr server depot
bash scripts/install.sh /mnt/server

echo "==> Install complete."
echo "    Runtime container will boot via:  bash /home/container/scripts/pelican-entrypoint.sh"

variables.name: Steam App ID
variables.description: Funcom dedicated-server depot to install. 4754530 = Production (retail); 3104830 = Public Test (PTC). Both are anonymous-accessible — no Steam login required.

variables.name: Release Version
variables.description: Must match Steam App ID. Used by prestart.sh to select retail vs beta FLS environment. Set to 4754530 for retail, 3104830 for PTC.

variables.name: Self-Host Service Token (DUNE_JWT)
variables.description: Funcom JWT from https://account.duneawakening.com/ (or account-pts.duneawakening.com for PTC). TREAT AS A SECRET. Each running battlegroup needs its own unique token.

variables.name: World Title
variables.description: Display name in the in-game server browser.

variables.name: Region
variables.description: Region label, e.g. 'Europe', 'North America', 'Europe Test'. Shown to players in the server browser.

variables.name: World Name Override
variables.description: Optional. Paste a previously FLS-registered WorldName to keep the same battlegroup identity after wiping state. Leave blank to auto-generate on first boot (and never change after).

variables.name: Datacenter ID
variables.description: Free-form label for FLS provider identification.

variables.name: Bind IP
variables.description: What internal services bind to inside the container. Almost always 0.0.0.0 (all interfaces). Wings sets this for you in most cases.

variables.name: External (Public) IP
variables.description: Your public WAN IP, advertised to clients via FLS. If the panel knows the node's public IP, set this manually to match. Required.

variables.name: Game Port Base (UDP)
variables.description: Base UDP port for the UE5 instance pool. Funcom uses 7777 by default; Wings allocates 7777-7806 (30 slots) for this server. SERVER_PORT is wired to this value.

variables.name: RabbitMQ Game Port (TCP/TLS)
variables.description: TLS AMQP endpoint advertised to clients via FLS. Funcom uses 5673.

variables.name: RabbitMQ Game Mgmt Port (TCP)
variables.description: HTTP management endpoint advertised to clients for token auth. Funcom uses 15673.

variables.name: Server Join Password
variables.description: Password players must enter to join any sietch in this battlegroup. Default 'Sandworm' comes from Funcom's template — change it to keep your server private. Special characters: avoid double quotes (they break the INI parser).

variables.name: Server Display Name
variables.description: Display name shown for every sietch in the battlegroup browser. Defaults to Funcom's template 'My Arrakis, My Dune'. Avoid double quotes.

variables.name: Mining Output Multiplier
variables.description: Hand-mined resource yield scalar. 1.0 = normal Funcom default. Higher = more ore per pickaxe swing. Maps to Dune.GlobalMiningOutputMultiplier.

variables.name: Vehicle Mining Output Multiplier
variables.description: Vehicle-mining resource yield scalar (sandcrawlers, etc.). 1.0 = normal. Maps to Dune.GlobalVehicleMiningOutputMultiplier.

variables.name: PvP Zone Resource Bonus
variables.description: Bonus multiplier applied to resource yields inside PvP-enabled zones. Funcom default 2.5. Maps to SecurityZones.PvpResourceMultiplier.

variables.name: Vehicle Durability Damage
variables.description: Damage scalar applied to vehicle durability. 0 disables vehicle damage entirely, 1.0 = normal, 10 = maximum. Maps to dw.VehicleDurabilityDamageMultiplier.

variables.name: Sandworm Invuln (Vehicle Exit, seconds)
variables.description: Window in seconds during which a player is safe from sandworms after exiting a vehicle. Funcom default 900 (15 min). Maps to Vehicle.SandwormInvulnerabilitySecondsOnExit.

variables.name: Sandworm Invuln (Server Restart, seconds)
variables.description: Window in seconds during which players are safe from sandworms after the server restarts. Funcom default 7200 (2 h). Maps to Vehicle.SandwormInvulnerabilitySecondsOnServerRestart.

variables.name: Sandworm Can Damage Vehicles
variables.description: If True, sandworms can push and damage vehicles on contact. Funcom default False. Maps to Vehicle.SandwormCollisionInteraction.

variables.name: Sandstorms Enabled
variables.description: Enable scheduled sandstorm weather events. Funcom default True. Maps to Sandstorm.Enabled.

variables.name: Sandstorm Treasure Drops
variables.description: Enable bonus loot drops during sandstorms. Funcom default True. Maps to Sandstorm.Treasure.Enabled.

variables.name: Sandworms Enabled
variables.description: Enable sandworm spawns globally. Funcom default True. Maps to sandworm.dune.Enabled.

variables.name: Sandworm Danger Zones Visible
variables.description: Show on-map danger-zone overlays where sandworms can attack. Funcom default True. Maps to Sandworm.SandwormDangerZonesEnabled.

variables.name: Force PvP On All Partitions
variables.description: If True, every map allows PvP regardless of its partition's PvP/PvE setting. Funcom default False. Maps to /Script/DuneSandbox.PvpPveSettings.m_bShouldForceEnablePvpOnAllPartitions.

variables.name: Security Zones (Safe Zones) Enabled
variables.description: If False, PvP and abilities are permitted everywhere with no safe-zone protection. Funcom default True. Maps to /Script/DuneSandbox.SecurityZonesSubsystem.m_bAreSecurityZonesEnabled.

variables.name: Coriolis Storm Auto-Spawn
variables.description: Allow Coriolis storms to spawn automatically. Funcom default True. Maps to /Script/DuneSandbox.SandStormConfig.m_bCoriolisAutoSpawnEnabled.

variables.name: Item Deterioration Rate (seconds)
variables.description: Item deterioration tick interval in seconds. 0 disables item decay entirely, 1.0 = normal (Funcom default), 10 = fastest. Maps to /DeteriorationSystem.ItemDeteriorationConstants.UpdateRateInSeconds.

variables.name: Max Landclaim Segments Per Player
variables.description: Maximum number of land-claim flags one player may own at the same time. Funcom default 6. Maps to /Script/DuneSandbox.BuildingSettings.m_MaxNumLandclaimSegments.

variables.name: Building Blueprint Max Extensions
variables.description: How many times a blueprinted building can be extended past its base footprint. Funcom default 4. Maps to /Script/DuneSandbox.BuildingSettings.m_BuildingBlueprintMaxExtensions.

variables.name: Base Backup Max Extensions
variables.description: How many times a base backup can be extended. Funcom default 8. Maps to /Script/DuneSandbox.BuildingSettings.m_BaseBackupMaxExtensions.

variables.name: Building Restriction Limits Enforced
variables.description: Enforce server-side limits on where players may build (dungeons, POIs, etc.). Funcom default True. Maps to /Script/DuneSandbox.BuildingSettings.m_bBuildingRestrictionLimitsEnabled.

variables.name: Max Concurrent UE5 Instances
variables.description: Hard cap on UE5 server instances mock-k8s will run at once. Must be at least the always-warm map count or maps fail to come up. Pelican default 8.

variables.name: On-Demand Idle Timeout (Go duration)
variables.description: How long an empty on-demand UE5 instance stays warm before mock-k8s despawns it. Go-style duration (e.g. 30s, 10m, 1h). Pelican default 10m.

variables.name: Always-Warm Maps
variables.description: Comma-separated maps kept running at all times (don't scale on demand). Each kept-warm map consumes a slot from Max Concurrent Instances. Default Survival_1,Overmap,DeepDesert_1.
